example.extension.name: Example: Permissions-Policy
example.permissions_policy.title: Browser features restricted (Permissions-Policy)
example.permissions_policy.why: This header tells the browser that the website uses no camera, microphone or location: a rigged script then cannot ask for them.
example.permissions_policy.no_website: No website: this check does not apply.
example.permissions_policy.message:
Hello,

Could you add the following header on {host}?

Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()

Thank you.
